name: hashira-npm-release-dry-run-fixture
description: Static fixture for the npm-release dry-run self-CI job (iteration 3.4 rewrite). The self-CI job `npm pack`s this directory into a .tgz, uploads it under the artifact name 'npm-tarball' (the same name npm-package-ci.yml's real `version` job uses), then invokes the npm-release composite with HASHIRA_NPM_RELEASE_DRY_RUN=1 — proving the REAL actions/download-artifact + tarball-locate steps end-to-end, while the dry-run flag skips only the actual `npm publish` and tag/release steps (the network-touching, irreversible parts). 'private: true' is harmless here (npm publish --dry-run/no-op paths never inspect it), kept for defense-in-depth in case this fixture is ever packed by a tool that does.
